title: VTC Community — Theme — Update — payload
description: The whole new stylesheet, which replaces the stored one. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

stylesheet.description: The new theme stylesheet, in the theme profile. The empty string removes the theme.

dryRun.description: Absent means false. When true the community checks the stylesheet and answers with what it would store, and stores nothing.

Response.title: VTC Community — Theme — Update — response payload

stylesheet.description: The stylesheet as stored — or, on a dry run, as it would be stored.

stored.description: False on a dry run and when the stylesheet equals the one already stored; true when the stored theme changed.

updatedAt.description: When the stored theme was last replaced. Absent on a dry run, and when the community has never set one.
